sample_unit: chatbot ophthalmologist recommendations (80 per chatbot x 3 chatbots)

links.outcome: Accuracy of consumer chatbot recommendations of ophthalmologists (specialty and location correctness)
links.effect: Inaccurate recommendations: ChatGPT 73.8%, Bing Chat 67.5%, Bard 62.5%; most recommendations were non-ophthalmologists or not in or near the desired city.
links.quote: ChatGPT (73.8%), Bing Chat (67.5%), and Bard (62.5%) gave high rates of inaccurate recommendations.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM chatbots on simulated patient queries seeking ophthalmologist recommendations, measuring gender bias and recommendation accuracy without testing an intervention or guardrail.
